init_measurement_observer: create a MeasurementObserver instance to track observation statistics during an environment episode
observe_first_reset: call observe_first to reset the measurements list at the start of a new episode
observe_record_step: call observe to record an environment timestep observation into the measurements list
get_metrics_aggregate: call get_metrics to retrieve max, min, mean, and percentile statistics for all recorded measurements
use_in_env_loop: add a MeasurementObserver to an Acme environment loop to automatically track per-timestep observation statistics
